The luck-weighted Voidheart, beside the jar's own flat Voidheart roll in Disenchant_Void. Named by Extensions/DisenchantingProgression.json (and its greater child) and rolled once per ritual at the Payout beat, at both tables. A FIND: no Expected leaf, so it lands as a gold row, with the jar action's own Voidheart cue. It sits in a file of its own, apart from Mmo_Disenchant_Void_Finds, so a station stat can roll it again on its own: Mmo_Disenchant_Talents re-rolls it for the rarest-find stat (Heart Seeker, Rare Woods).

THE GUARDRAIL. A mithril weapon costs a Voidheart to forge, and the heart here starts at a fifth of a percent and stops at 0.8: with the jar's own 0.8 that is about one heart per hundred mithril weapons unmade at no luck and one per seventy at full luck, each of which cost a heart to make; the rarest-find stat at its tree peak rolls this file again on about a third of rituals, which still leaves a heart rarer than one per fifty pieces.

Every chance and gate is balance data; retune by shipping a same-id file from a pack loading after this one.

Rolls.$Comment: The Voidheart: gear of item level 45 and up, a fifth of a percent plus a two-hundredth per luck point, held under 0.8 percent.
